en: A black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a mass grave. A man in heavy winter clothing and a fur hat stands in a deep earthen pit filled with numerous naked or partially clothed corpses, many extremely emaciated. He is lifting one of the bodies by the legs. The setting appears muddy and cold; the walls of the pit are rough earth. There is no visible border design or caption on the image side, only the stark documentary photograph.
